case_title: Small proactive recovery on a mild delay
exception_description: Order CS-P05-1198 will arrive about 2 hours late. The customer is a repeat buyer but has not complained. AI proposes sending an automatic delay notice with a small goodwill coupon.
layer1_visible: Order CS-P05-1198 will arrive about 2 hours late. The customer is a repeat buyer but has not complained. AI proposes sending an automatic delay notice with a small goodwill coupon.
detail_expand: The order value is moderate and the account has no recent escalations. Shipping is still on the same day, so the operational risk is limited. Doing nothing saves a small direct cost now, but can create an avoidable contact and complaint later if the delay surprises the customer during delivery.
ai_recommendation: AI recommends sending the notice and small coupon because a light proactive recovery is cheaper than handling a preventable complaint later.

decision_options.action_label: Send notice and small coupon now
Pause to review recent order history
Do nothing and wait for customer contact

current_disruptions.description: Customer-facing delay or dissatisfaction event; proactive recovery recommended

traceability_text.trace_rationale_short: A small proactive recovery usually prevents costlier follow-up contacts.
traceability_text.trace_more: Audit log stores CRM tier, offer sent, and message timestamp.
traceability_text.recommended_check: Review the customer tier and recent-contact history in CRM.

feedback_text.feedback_ai_outcome: The message prevented a complaint and the small coupon resolved the issue efficiently.
feedback_text.feedback_alt1_outcome: The review confirmed the same plan, but the extra checking added delay and handling cost.
feedback_text.feedback_alt2_outcome: No complaint occurred, so the heavier response created unnecessary recovery expense.
